title: French-Palestinian MEP Rima Hassan to be tried for 'advocating terrorism' in X post
summary: Rima Hassan, a European Parliament member from the France Unbowed (LFI) party who is of Palestinian descent, will face trial in July on charges of "advocating terrorism" online over a message on X she posted last month.
